title: Solution Architect & Delivery Lead – Enterprise AI & Data Platforms
description:
**Role Summary**

We are looking for a hands-on Solution Architect to lead the architecture and delivery of enterprise AI transformation programs. This role will be responsible for designing scalable AI solutions, leading multidisciplinary engineering teams, and ensuring successful implementation of AI, Data Engineering, and Modern Data Platform initiatives.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with strong consulting and customer-facing experience, enabling organizations to modernize data platforms and operationalize Enterprise AI at scale.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design enterprise-scale solution architectures across Data Engineering, Modern Data Platforms, Enterprise AI, Generative AI, and Agentic AI.
* Lead technical discovery workshops and translate business requirements into scalable solution architectures.
* Own the end-to-end technical delivery of AI transformation engagements.
* Provide architectural leadership across Data Platforms, AI applications, and intelligent automation initiatives.
* Lead and mentor multidisciplinary engineering teams across AI, Data Engineering, and Platform Engineering.
* Establish architecture standards, engineering best practices, and delivery governance.
* Conduct solution reviews and ensure quality throughout the delivery lifecycle.
* Act as the trusted technical advisor for enterprise customers.
* Build reusable AI accelerators, reference architectures, and delivery frameworks.
* Collaborate closely with Client Engagement teams to support solutioning and strategic pursuits.

**Required Skills**

* 12+ years of experience in Enterprise Architecture, Solution Architecture, Data Engineering, or Cloud Engineering.
* Strong experience designing and delivering enterprise Data Platform and AI solutions.
* Hands-on expertise in Data Engineering, Enterprise AI, Generative AI, and Agentic AI.
* Experience with modern data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, or equivalent technologies.
* Strong understanding of LLMs, RAG architectures, AI Agents, AI orchestration frameworks, and enterprise AI adoption.
* Experience architecting cloud-native solutions on Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Proven ability to lead enterprise-scale implementation programs and technical teams.
* Excellent consulting, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience working with Fortune 1000 customers and complex enterprise transformation programs is preferred.

title: Principal Solution Architect, IT Software [T500-29847]
description:
**ANSR is hiring for one of its clients.**

**About American Airlines:**

To Care for People on Life's Journey®. Together with our American Eagle regional partners, we offer thousands of flights daily to more than 350 destinations in more than 60 countries.

American Airlines is transforming the way it delivers technology to its customers and team members worldwide.

American’s Tech Hub in Hyderabad, India, is our latest technology office location and home to team members who drive technical innovation and engineer unrivalled digital products to best serve American’s customers and team members. With U.S. tech hubs in Dallas-Fort Worth, Texas and Phoenix, Arizona, our new team in Hyderabad, India enables better support of our 24/7 operation and positions American to deliver industry-leading technology solutions that create a world-class customer experience.

**Why You'll Love This Job:**

The Customer Mobile Applications team is responsible for delivering world-class digital experiences across iOS, Android, and the backend services that power them. This team owns customer-facing mobile experiences supporting millions of users through scalable Java and JavaScript services deployed across a multi-cloud ecosystem.

As a Principal Solution Architect, you will drive the technical vision, architecture strategy, and engineering standards across mobile applications and supporting platforms. You will work closely with Product, Engineering Managers, Principal Engineers, and cross-functional partners to build highly scalable, secure, and reliable solutions that improve customer experience and business outcomes. This role requires both hands-on technical leadership and strategic architectural thinking.

**What You'll Do:**

* Define and evolve application architecture for customer-facing mobile platforms and backend services.
* Lead architecture and design reviews for Java, and JavaScript-based solutions.
* Collaborate with iOS and Android leads.
* Establish technical standards, engineering best practices, and architectural governance across multiple squads.
* Drive modernization initiatives including cloud-native architectures, microservices, APIs, event-driven systems, and platform scalability.
* Partner with Product Owners and Engineering Managers during roadmap planning, PI planning, and solution definition activities.
* Guide teams in designing secure, highly available, performant, and resilient systems.
* Lead multi-cloud architecture strategy across AWS, Azure, and other cloud platforms as required.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend adoption strategies that align with business goals.
* Define integration patterns between mobile applications, enterprise platforms, third-party partners, and cloud services.
* Collaborate with cybersecurity, infrastructure, and enterprise architecture teams to ensure compliance and operational readiness.
* Provide technical mentorship to engineers and technical leads across multiple teams.
* Participate in production readiness reviews, incident analysis, root cause investigations, and continuous improvement activities.
* Drive adoption of AI-assisted development, automation, observability, and DevSecOps practices.
* Ensure solutions align with accessibility, privacy, security, and regulatory requirements.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

**Education & Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related discipline, or equivalent experience.
* 10+ years of software engineering experience.
* 5+ years of software architecture or technical leadership experience.
* Experience designing and delivering large-scale customer-facing digital products.

**Technical Experience:**

* Strong expertise with Java and modern backend frameworks (Spring Boot, REST APIs, Microservices).
* Experience with JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystems and modern web technologies.
* Strong understanding of iOS and Android application architectures and mobile development best practices.
* Experience designing event-driven and API-first architectures.
* Experience with cloud-native architectures and containerized applications.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps, and Infrastructure as Code.
* Strong knowledge of distributed systems, performance optimization, and scalability patterns.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience supporting enterprise mobile applications with millions of customers.
* Experience with AWS and Azure cloud platforms.
* Knowledge of Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud-native deployment models.
* Experience with observability platforms, monitoring, logging, and operational excellence practices.
* Background in airline, travel, hospitality, retail, or other high-volume customer-facing industries.
* Experience implementing AI-accelerated engineering solutions.
* Familiarity with SAFe Agile delivery frameworks and PI Planning.
* Experience leading globally distributed engineering teams

**What Success Looks Like:**

* Establishes a modern architecture strategy for mobile and backend platforms.
* Improves scalability, reliability, and engineering velocity across teams.
* Drives consistency in architecture standards and engineering practices.
* Reduces technical debt while enabling faster feature delivery.
* Enables secure, compliant, and highly available customer experiences across mobile ecosystems.
* Serves as a trusted technical advisor to product, engineering, and business leadership.

**Technologies Typically Used:**

* Java, Spring Boot
* JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js
* REST, GraphQL, Event Streaming
* AWS, Azure
* Kubernetes, Docker
* GitHub, Azure DevOps
* Datadog, Splunk, Dynatrace
* AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, OpenAI, LLM-based engineering solutions)

**LANGUAGE / COMMUNICATION SKILLS:**

* Ability to effectively communicate both verbally and written with all levels within the organization
* Physical ability necessary to safely and successfully perform the essential functions of the position, with or without any legally required reasonable accommodations that do not pose an undue hardship. Note: If the Company has reason to question an employee’s physical ability to safely and/or successfully perform the position’s essential job functions, the HR team generally will engage in an interactive process to determine whether a reasonable accommodation is appropriate.

title: SAP AI Consultant - Joule
description:
**Role Summary**

We are seeking an experienced SAP AI & Joule Specialist/Architect to design, build, and deploy enterprise-grade AI solutions using SAP Joule, Joule Studio, SAP Build, and SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP). The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between SAP functional knowledge and cutting-edge AI capabilities to deliver intelligent, automated business solutions that enhance user productivity and drive measurable business impact. You will play a key role in shaping and delivering high-value assignments around SAP Business AI, Joule, and SAP BTP AI capabilities.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Joule Development & AI Solution Delivery**

* Design, develop, and deploy custom Joule Skills, capabilities, extensions, and AI agents using Joule Studio and SAP Build.
* Build and orchestrate agentic AI workflows that automate decision-making and business processes by combining LLMs, structured SAP data, and enterprise APIs.
* Design conversational AI flows, prompt engineering strategies, and agent orchestration logic to deliver intuitive, context-aware user experiences.
* Develop and configure AI-powered use cases using SAP AI Core and SAP AI Launchpad.
* Implement RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) patterns and Knowledge Graph integrations for advanced, context-aware AI solutions.

**Integration & Platform Expertise**

* Integrate Joule with SAP S/4HANA, SuccessFactors, Ariba, SAP Datasphere, and other SAP solutions, as well as third-party REST APIs.
* Design and deploy scalable, secure, and high-performing AI-powered applications on SAP BTP.
* Utilize SAP BTP services such as SAP Generative AI Hub, SAP AI Core, SAP AI Business Services, and SAP Integration Suite to develop innovative solutions.
* Build API-driven conversational experiences and integrate SAP and non-SAP systems through SAP BTP.

**Architecture & Governance**

* Define enterprise AI architecture, design agent frameworks, and create secure, scalable AI workflows.
* Establish and enforce data governance, security, and compliance frameworks across SAP and non-SAP platforms, aligning with enterprise policies and SAP best practices.
* Stay current with SAP's evolving Generative/Agentic AI roadmap and bring innovation to the team.

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Collaborate with functional teams to identify and prioritize AI automation opportunities across business processes.
* Lead AI architecture workshops, mentor development teams, and define coding standards.
* Conduct POCs (Proof of Concepts) and demos for stakeholders to showcase AI capabilities.

**Required Qualifications**

**Experience**

* 5–15 years of total experience in SAP development, consulting, or architecture roles, with a strong focus on AI-driven solutions.
* Proven experience with SAP Joule, including at least 2 enterprise implementations (custom Skills, Agents, or AI-powered business processes).
* 5+ years of hands-on SAP BTP development experience.
* Experience across the full AI use-case lifecycle—from refining user stories and designing AI functionalities to implementing them with a focus on AI quality, robustness, and compliance.

**Technical Skills**

* **SAP AI Stack:**
  SAP Joule, Joule Studio, SAP Build, SAP AI Core, SAP AI Launchpad, SAP BTP.
* **SAP Development:**
  ABAP, CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model), RAP, CDS Views, SAP Fiori, SAPUI5, OData, SAP Integration Suite.
* **AI & ML:**
  Prompt Engineering, Agent Design, RAG Architecture, LLM Integration, Conversational Design, AI Governance.
* **Programming Languages:**
  Python, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js.
* **Cloud & Data:**
  SAP HANA Cloud, SAP Datasphere, SAP BDC, Vector Engines, Knowledge Graphs.

**Soft Skills**

* Excellent problem-solving, communication, and leadership skills.
* Ability to communicate complex architectural options, risks, and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong business process acumen and the ability to understand the challenges you are asked to solve.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* SAP BTP Solution Architect Certification.
* SAP Business AI, Joule, or SAP Business AI certification.
* Experience with machine learning frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch).
* Familiarity with agentic AI frameworks and multi-agent systems.
* Experience leading enterprise AI programs and supporting 10,000+ users globally.
* Domain expertise in regulated industries (Healthcare, Pharma, Manufacturing, Financial Services).

**Why Join Us?**

* Work on SAP's flagship AI investment, Joule, and contribute to shaping the future of enterprise AI.
* Collaborate with a global, innovative team at the forefront of SAP's AI evolution.
* Access continuous learning, skill growth, and opportunities for personal development

title: Salesforce Architect - FSL
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
**Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end solution architecture for Salesforce Field Service programs - application intent, target-state design, integration landscape, and governing artifacts including context diagrams, data models, and architecture decision records
* Design scalable, secure solutions across the platform, defending build-vs-configure and AppExchange decisions on total cost of ownership, and defining the org-wide data model, sharing and security architecture, and large-data-volume strategy covering skew mitigation, selective indexing, and archiving
* Establish technical governance: design review gates, Apex and LWC coding standards, DevOps and release architecture, sandbox and environment strategy, and technical debt remediation roadmaps
* Architect Field Service implementations across the work order lifecycle, service appointments, service resources, crews, operating hours, and territory design for [X] technicians in [X] territories
* Design the scheduling and optimization model - scheduling policies, work rules, service objectives, Enhanced Scheduling and Optimization, emergency dispatch, and appointment booking - tuned against SLA attainment, travel time, and technician utilization
* Define mobile and dispatcher architecture: Field Service Mobile offline priming and briefcase rules, mobile flows, service report templates, and Dispatcher Console Gantt configuration and territory visibility
* Architect asset, maintenance, and inventory models - asset hierarchies, maintenance plans and work rules, product items, product requests, part transfers, van stock replenishment - along with entitlement, milestone, and escalation models that enforce contractual SLAs
* Set Lightning Web Component architecture: component library and design system standards, Lightning Data Service vs imperative Apex patterns,Lightning Message Service for cross-component communication, Jest coverage thresholds, and the Aura and Visualforce migration roadmap
* Architect integrations using REST and SOAP APIs, Apex REST, Named Credentials, External Services, and event-driven patterns with Platform Events and Change Data Capture, defining API contracts, canonical data models, idempotency, and retry and dead-letter handling
* Define middleware architecture on [MuleSoft/Boomi], connecting field service to [SAP/Oracle] for parts, invoicing, and warranty, and to [Twilio/Google Maps/DocuSign] for notifications, geocoding, and signed service reports, while governing high-volume data movement and platform limits through Bulk and Composite APIs, asynchronous Apex, Platform Cache, and OAuth 2.0 JWT authentication
* Define the AI architecture for service operations, selecting between Einstein predictive models, Data Cloud, Agentforce, and Prompt Builder based on data readiness and business value
* Design and deploy Agentforce agents and Prompt Builder templates grounded in CRM and Data Cloud data, applying retrieval-augmented generation, the Einstein Trust Layer, prompt versioning, and evaluation practices, with responsible-AI guardrails for data masking, grounding checks, human-in-the-loop review, and audit trails
* Architect predictive use cases such as [first-time fix rate, SLA breach risk, appointment no-show, skill matching], defining the underlying data quality, feature, and monitoring requirements
* Lead and mentor a Salesforce engineering team of [X] across onshore and offshore locations, owning hiring, onboarding, goal setting, performance reviews, career development, and capacity planning across [X] concurrent programs
* Run delivery operations in both Agile and Waterfall models - estimation, sprint and release planning, risk and dependency management, and partner coordination - and define and report metrics on velocity, defect leakage, code coverage, SLA attainment, and release success
* Plan and facilitate requirements elicitation workshops to capture functional and non-functional requirements, involving developers in requirements-stage analysis, and author requirements management plans, BRDs, FRDs, and process and data flow diagrams to best-practice standards
* Serve as escalation point and offshore representative to clients and executive stakeholders, presenting architecture, roadmaps, and status to senior audiences, and build practice capability through certification paths, reusable assets, and capability decks
* Stay hands-on as needed, prototyping complex components and integrations to de-risk designs before handover to the team
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

**Required Qualifications**

* Graduate degree or equivalent experience
* 11+ years in software development, including 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce experience in an architect, technical lead, or engineering management capacity
* 5+ years leading engineering and Agile teams, with 4+ years in Scrum or SAFe and demonstrated people management including hiring, performance management, mentoring, and capability building
* 3+ years architecting and delivering Salesforce Field Service - scheduling policies and optimization, Dispatcher Console, mobile offline configuration, and the work order, asset, and inventory data model
* Deep platform development expertise in Apex, asynchronous Apex, triggers, SOQL and SOSL optimization, Flow, and Lightning Web Components, with Visualforce and Aura for legacy maintenance and migration
* Proven integration architecture experience across REST and SOAP APIs, Apex REST, Platform Events, Change Data Capture, Bulk and Composite APIs, OAuth 2.0 flows, Named Credentials, and middleware such as MuleSoft or Boomi
* Experience defining the data model, large-data-volume strategy, and technical governance standards for an enterprise org
* Salesforce DevOps and release management experience using SFDX, CI/CD pipelines, and version control
* Working knowledge of AI and generative AI on the platform - Einstein prediction and scoring, Agentforce, Prompt Builder, Data Cloud, Einstein Trust Layer - plus core concepts including RAG, prompt engineering, embeddings, and model evaluation and guardrails
* Practical understanding of Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Experience Cloud, with the ability to model standard and custom objects and relationships for the right solution fit
* Proven solid command of the Salesforce sharing and security model: OWD, role hierarchy, sharing rules, Apex sharing, field-level security, and record and platform encryption
* Proven track record on large-scale implementations - multi-quarter, multi-team programs with enterprise integration footprints and concurrent project delivery
* Proven solid requirements elicitation skills and excellent verbal, written, and presentation communication with both business and technical audiences

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advance Developer Certification (PD-2)
* Sales & Service Cloud Certifications
* Salesforce certifications: Application or System Architect, Field Service Consultant, Platform Developer II, and Agentforce Specialist
* Health Cloud experience
* Lightening API Framework experience
* UI experience, Any JS Framework (JQuery, Angular JS,CSS)

description:
**About the Company**

COMPANY OVERVIEW AND JOB SUMMARYUSTECH Solutions is a global IT services partner to Fortune 500 companies, delivering AI, Data, Cloud and Application Services at enterprise scale. Our work sits inside our clients' core systems — in financial services, insurance, healthcare and enterprise SaaS — where engineering quality, security and regulatory posture matter as much as speed. The Forward Deployed Engineering practice is how we bring that capability directly into a client's engineering organization.

**About the Role**

The FDE Lead is the senior technologist we embed inside a client's engineering organization to turn an AI ambition into running, supported software. The role carries two jobs at once: solution architect for the application estate being changed, and engineering lead for the agentic systems built on top of it. You own the architecture from first business requirement through production release and hypercare, and you lead the pod that ships it. FDE Leads are embedded from week one and work in small senior pods, helping the client decide what is worth building, building it, and staying accountable through to production support. The role carries unusual latitude: you shape the roadmap alongside client architects, make the technology calls, and answer for the outcome. You are the technical face of USTECH Solutions in front of client engineering leadership and CXOs.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: APPLICATION SOLUTION ARCHITECTURE**

* Own end-to-end solution architecture for the applications in scope: current-state assessment, target-state blueprint, HLD and LLD, interface contracts and the migration path between them.
* Select the stack and patterns deliberately — microservices vs. modular monolith, event-driven vs. request-response, API gateway, caching, transaction boundaries — with trade-offs documented.
* Design the integration layer to legacy and packaged systems (core banking, ERP, mainframe, CRM) through secure abstraction layers, API facades and event streams rather than point-to-point coupling.
* Define the shared data architecture: canonical models, data contracts, lineage, masking and residency rules.
* Set and defend non-functional requirements — availability, latency, scalability, resilience, DR, observability, cost per transaction — and prove them through load and failure testing.
* Build security and compliance into the design (authN/authZ, secrets, encryption, SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA as applicable) and produce the artifacts the client's architecture review board needs: ADRs, design documents, sequence and deployment diagrams, threat models, estimation models.
* Govern engineering quality across the pod: code standards, review discipline, test coverage, CI/CD, IaC and technical debt tracking.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: AGENTIC AI AND PLATFORM ENGINEERING**

* Architect and deploy intent-driven agentic workflows against real domain logic — underwriting, claims, regulatory checking, reconciliation, servicing, order-to-cash, IT operations.
* Build and tune context-aware RAG pipelines and vector store architectures over disparate enterprise sources, owning chunking, embedding, retrieval evaluation and drift.
* Implement Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, tool and function calling, and multi-agent orchestration so agents act on enterprise systems within scoped permissions.
* Stand up evaluation frameworks and AI observability: golden datasets, regression suites, accuracy thresholds, latency and token cost tracking, tracing and prompt versioning.
* Establish guardrails and AI governance — deterministic controls, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, PII redaction, audit trails, model and prompt change management.
* Apply AI-native engineering to our own delivery (agent-assisted development, automated test and edge-case generation) and evidence the productivity gained.
* Stay platform-pragmatic across Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, OpenAI and Anthropic, choosing per problem, cost envelope and client constraint.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: CLIENT ENGAGEMENT AND DELIVERY LEADERSHIP**

* Embed inside client engineering teams as a trusted technical advisor, operating with high autonomy through discovery ambiguity and directly in front of stakeholders.
* Translate business intent into technical specifications the pod and the agents can execute against, including domain constraints and acceptance criteria; challenge weak use cases early rather than building them.
* Present architecture, security posture, evaluation results and business outcomes to client engineering leadership and C-level stakeholders (CTO, CIO, CPO, Chief Risk Officer).
* Lead a small senior onshore-offshore pod through shaping, build, evaluation, release and hypercare, with visible delivery governance and honest status against committed outcomes.
* Support pre-sales for the practice: solution shaping, RFP and RFI responses, technical proposals, estimation, pricing inputs, proofs of concept and client workshops.
* Mentor engineers and architects, and contribute reusable accelerators, reference architectures and playbooks to the USTECH Solutions asset library from every engagement.

**KEY MEASURES OF SUCCESS**

* Production deploymentsEvery engagement reaches production; no prototype handed over without a production path
* Client outcomeValue evidenced in the client's own metrics, and a client willing to act as a reference
* Engineering velocityMeasured reduction in feature-to-production cycle time, review turnaround and manual test effort
* Quality and trustEvaluation and accuracy thresholds met before release; no security or compliance escalations
* Account growthFollow-on scope originating from the embedded work
* Reusable IP and talentAccelerators contributed from every engagement; pod members taking on architecture ownership

**MUST-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE**

* 15+ years in software engineering, application architecture, platform engineering or solution architecture, including 8+ years delivering high-scale enterprise products or services.

* Full-stack depth across at least one primary ecosystem (Java / Spring, .NET, Node or Python), plus APIs, messaging, relational and NoSQL data stores, and cloud-native deployment on Azure, AWS or GCP.

title: Enterprise AI Architect - AI Product Design & Solutioning
description:
**Location:**
Hyderabad, India, Hybrid

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
8–12 years total, with at least 4 years in architecture roles and 2+ years building AI/ML solutions in production

**Compensation:**
₹32–48 LPA fixed

**About Assentcode Technologies**

Assentcode Technologies is a Hyderabad-based software services company, founded in 2019 by a group of entrepreneurial engineers. We help businesses across the globe build, modernize, and scale their technology, with offices in Hyderabad and Frisco, Texas (USA).

Our core services include:

* Product Engineering (product design and development, web and mobile apps, UI/UX)
* Data Analytics, AI/ML, chatbots, and virtual assistants
* Cloud solutions, DevOps, and CI/CD
* Legacy modernization and digital transformation
* Custom enterprise software and quality engineering

We are a lean, fast-moving team, and AI is one of our biggest growth areas. We are looking for an enterprise architect who can turn a client's business problem into a well-designed, production-grade AI solution.

**About the Role**

As our Enterprise AI Architect, you will own the technical design of AI products and solutions for our enterprise clients, from the first discovery conversation to production architecture. You will decide what to build, which models and patterns to use, how it integrates with the client's systems, and how it stays secure, reliable, and cost-effective at scale. This is a hands-on architecture role: you will define the blueprint, guide the delivery team, and stay close enough to the code to validate that what's built matches what was designed.

You will also work closely with our business development team as the technical voice in client conversations, so you should be comfortable explaining complex AI concepts to both engineers and executives.

**What You Will Own**

Client Problem → Discovery → Solution Architecture → Proof of Concept → Estimation and Proposal → Delivery Guidance → Production Readiness → Continuous Improvement

**Key Responsibilities**

*Solution Design and Architecture*

* Translate business problems into AI solution architectures, including GenAI/LLM applications, RAG systems, AI agents, predictive models, and intelligent automation
* Select the right approach for each problem: build vs. buy, open-source vs. proprietary models, fine-tuning vs. RAG vs. prompt engineering, and when AI is not the right answer
* Design end-to-end architectures covering data ingestion, vector stores, model serving, orchestration, APIs, integration with enterprise systems, and user-facing applications
* Create architecture documents, solution blueprints, and technical diagrams that delivery teams can build from

*Client and Pre-Sales Engagement*

* Join discovery workshops with CTOs, CIOs, and business leaders to understand objectives, constraints, and data readiness
* Support the business development team with technical proposals, SOW inputs, effort estimates, and architecture presentations
* Build and demo proofs of concept to validate feasibility and win client confidence
* Present trade-offs, risks, and timelines honestly, and manage client expectations on what AI can and cannot deliver

*Delivery Leadership*

* Provide technical direction to engineering, data, and DevOps teams during implementation
* Review designs and code for architectural integrity, scalability, and maintainability
* Define standards for LLMOps/MLOps: CI/CD for models, monitoring, versioning, evaluation, and rollback
* Mentor engineers and help build our internal AI capability

*Quality, Security, and Governance*

* Establish evaluation frameworks for AI quality: accuracy, hallucination rates, latency, cost per query, and bias
* Design for data privacy, security, access control, and compliance (e.g., GDPR, SOC 2, HIPAA where relevant)
* Apply responsible AI practices, including guardrails, human-in-the-loop design, and auditability
* Optimize for performance and cloud cost without compromising reliability

*Innovation and Thought Leadership*

* Track the fast-moving AI landscape (models, frameworks, tools, and best practices) and decide what is ready for enterprise use
* Build reusable accelerators, reference architectures, and templates that speed up future projects
* Contribute to case studies, technical content, and our AI service positioning

**Must-Have Requirements**

* 8–12 years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or ML, with at least 3 years in an architect or technical lead role
* Hands-on experience designing and delivering AI/ML solutions that reached production, with examples you can walk us through
* Strong practical experience with Generative AI: LLM integration, RAG pipelines, vector databases, prompt engineering, and agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)
* Solid understanding of ML fundamentals and when to use classical ML vs. LLM-based approaches
* Deep experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and its AI/ML services (e.g., Bedrock, SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI)
* Strong software architecture skills: microservices, APIs, event-driven design, data pipelines, and system integration
* Strong Python skills and the ability to review code and build prototypes
* Experience with MLOps/LLMOps: model deployment, monitoring, evaluation, and CI/CD
* Understanding of data architecture, including data lakes, warehouses, ETL/ELT, and data quality
* Knowledge of security, privacy, and governance requirements for enterprise AI
* Excellent communication skills: able to explain architecture to executives and engineers alike
* Experience working with international clients and distributed teams

**Good to Have**

* Experience in a services, consulting, or multi-client environment
* Pre-sales or solutioning experience, including proposals, estimates, and client presentations
* Experience fine-tuning or evaluating open-source models (Llama, Mistral, etc.) and deploying them on your own infrastructure
* Familiarity with tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, Airflow, Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform
* Exposure to legacy modernization or integrating AI into existing enterprise applications
* Cloud architecture certifications (AWS, Azure, or GCP) or AI/ML specializations
* Contributions to open-source projects, published content, or conference talks
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field

**This Role May Not Be a Fit If You…**

* Have worked only on research, notebooks, or proofs of concept that never reached production
* Have only used AI through no-code tools or API wrappers, without architectural depth
* Prefer a purely advisory role with no involvement in implementation
* Are not comfortable engaging directly with clients and business stakeholders
* Want a large, highly structured organization with a fully defined process

**How Success Will Be Measured**

* Quality and clarity of architectures and solution designs delivered
* Technical contribution to proposals won and client confidence in pre-sales
* Successful delivery of AI projects to production, on time and within scope
* Reliability, performance, and cost-efficiency of deployed AI solutions
* Reusable accelerators and reference architectures created
* Growth in the team's AI capability through mentoring and standards

**Compensation and Benefits**

* Fixed salary of ₹32–48 LPA, based on experience and depth of AI delivery
* Performance-linked bonus tied to project outcomes and pre-sales contribution
* Direct access to founders and leadership, with real influence on our AI strategy and service offerings
* The chance to shape architecture standards and build our AI practice from the ground up
* Exposure to enterprise clients and our US office
* Learning support for cloud and AI certifications
* Statutory benefits (PF, gratuity) and health insurance
* A growth path toward Head of AI / Principal Architect / Chief Technology Officer-track roles

**How to Apply**

Apply through LinkedIn or email your resume to hr@assentcode.tech with the subject line "Enterprise AI Architect". To help us evaluate quickly, please include a short description (or link) of one AI solution you architected that went to production: the business problem, your architecture choices, the stack, and the outcome.

Learn more about us: www.assentcode.tech

The GAI Tech team is responsible for building infrastructure and applications of Generative AI (GAI) within the firm. The team's objectives consist of identifying the most productive GAI models, providing tools for sophisticated GAI-based applications, creating initial iterations of GAI tools, and offering support for technical staff involved with GAI projects. Embracing open-ended experimentation and ongoing evaluation is another critical aspect of GAI Tech's objectives, supporting the team's continuous quest to advance GAI models and techniques.

In this role, you will work on overseeing the end-to-end development of generative AI applications. title: CRM Solution/Data Architect (Senior Manager) – Pharma
description:

We seek highly motivated individuals with the dedication, integrity, and creative spirit needed to thrive in our organization.

**Principal Responsibilities**
**CRM & Enterprise Solution Architecture**

* Define and own the end-to-end CRM architecture strategy supporting Commercial, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Patient Services, and omnichannel engagement.
* Establish future-state architecture roadmaps across Salesforce Sales Cloud, Life Sciences Cloud, Data Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, CRM Analytics, Marketing Cloud, and emerging AI capabilities.
* Translate business strategy and product roadmaps into scalable solution architectures, technical designs, and implementation guardrails.
* Develop and govern architecture standards, reusable design patterns, platform principles, and technology blueprints across the CRM ecosystem.
* Evaluate new technologies and vendor capabilities against enterprise architecture, security, data, and business priorities.

**Data Architecture & Customer 360 Strategy**

* Lead customer data architecture across HCP, HCO, KOL, patient, account, territory, consent, affiliation, and engagement data domains.

**Integration & Platform Architecture**

* Architect integrations between Salesforce and Snowflake, IQVIA, customer master, ERP, data warehouse, marketing automation, patient services, sales enablement, and analytics platforms.
* Define API-led, middleware, batch, event-driven, and real-time integration patterns based on business and technical requirements.
* Ensure integration architecture meets scalability, resiliency, performance, monitoring, supportability, and security expectations.
* Guide delivery teams on platform interoperability, interface contracts, error handling, observability, and enterprise integration standards.

**AI, Analytics & Data Cloud Enablement**

* Partner with business and technology leaders to define AI-enabled CRM, field productivity, customer engagement, and decision-support use cases.
* Lead architecture for Salesforce Data Cloud, Agentforce, Einstein capabilities, predictive analytics, and customer intelligence initiatives.
* Ensure customer and engagement data is structured and governed to support segmentation, personalization, next best action, and advanced analytics.

* Define architecture governance covering design reviews, standards compliance, technology decisions, nonfunctional requirements, and release readiness.

* Establish security architecture standards for role-based access, classification, privacy, encryption, auditability, retention, and risk management.
* Lead architecture assessments for internal and vendor-delivered solutions, documenting decisions, risks, dependencies, and remediation actions.

**Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Provide thought leadership on CRM modernization, customer data strategy, AI adoption, and pharmaceutical engagement technologies.

* 12+ years of progressive experience in CRM, enterprise architecture, data architecture, or solution architecture, including leadership at a senior manager or equivalent level.
* 10+ years of Salesforce platform architecture experience with ownership of complex, enterprise-scale solutions.
* Deep expertise in Salesforce Sales Cloud, Life Sciences Cloud, Veeva, Data Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, CRM Analytics, and related capabilities.
* Strong knowledge of customer master data management, Customer 360, identity resolution, data governance, metadata management, and data quality.
* Experience architecting enterprise integrations using APIs, middleware, event-driven architecture, batch processing, and cloud-native patterns.
* Proven experience leading large-scale CRM transformation, platform modernization, data migration, and operating-model initiatives.
* Strong understanding of pharmaceutical processes including HCP/HCO engagement, Medical Affairs, patient services, KOL management, territory management, consent, compliance, and omnichannel engagement.

* Salesforce Certified Data Cloud Consultant

title: Integration Engineers (Consultant/ Sr Consultant)
description:

* Disproportionate Rewards for top performance

* Partner with Product/Engineering on platform capabilities, integration patterns, and enhancements needed for scalable client solutions.
* Build and maintain solutioning standards, reusable patterns, and technical documentation so the team can deliver consistently as engagement volume grows.
* A Senior Consultant will l ead a team of 5-6 Technical Consultants across regions — set priorities, review delivery quality, mentor on solutioning, and drive accountability for integration outcomes.

* 3-8 years of experience in technical consulting, integration solutioning/development, or similar roles within HRTech/SaaS or enterprise software.
* Proven experience leading Technical Consultants or similar delivery teams — including mentoring, quality oversight, and owning delivery outcomes.
* Strong hands-on programming ability in Python — comfortable writing, reading, reviewing, and debugging integration code.
* Solid expertise in system integrations (REST/SOAP APIs, file-based integrations, middleware) with the ability to design and solution complex integration landscapes.
* Demonstrated ability to help teams diagnose and resolve issues on integration interfaces in production environments.
* Experience engaging client leadership through demos, technical meetups, and executive-facing solution discussions.
* A quick learner who already uses AI tools for solutioning and writing code (e.g., LLM-based assistants, coding copilots) and can strengthen this practice across a delivery team.
* Excellent client-facing communication and stakeholder management skills — able to explain technical designs clearly and lead solution discussions with both technical and leadership audiences.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset with the ability to balance leadership responsibilities and hands-on technical contribution.

**Good to Have**

* JavaScript experience — a plus for integration builds, scripting, and related client-side or middleware work.
* Prior direct experience with the Darwinbox platform or similar HRMS/HCM products.
* Exposure to standard and custom integration patterns (SFTP, REST/SOAP APIs, middleware tools).
* Experience scaling AI-assisted solutioning and coding practices across a consulting or engineering team.

**What Success Looks Like:**
Within the first two quarters, this person will have established clear ownership of integration solutioning and development quality across their team, built a strong rhythm of client leadership demos and meetups, helped stabilize and resolve complex integration interface issues, and strengthened the team's existing AI-driven approach to solutioning and coding — leaving behind a high-performing, cross-region Technical Consultant team capable of scaling delivery with consistent quality.

When appropriate, oversees a broad portfolio of accounts. Manages and ensures the all-up delivery of consulting engagements, as necessary.

Identifies which ideas should be culled, with consideration for scale across customers. Drives the re-use of intellectual property and recommends practices in both pre-sales and delivery. description:

A senior enterprise architecture leadership role responsible for defining technology strategy, driving enterprise-wide modernization and transformation initiatives, and shaping future-state architectures across large, complex organizations.

**enterprise architecture, deep technical architecture credibility, consulting mindset, and stakeholder leadership**
. The Enterprise Architect is expected to engage senior business and technology leaders while providing architectural direction for large-scale, cloud-native and distributed systems.

**Qualifications**
**Educational Background**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, Mathematics, Economics, or related fields.

**Enterprise Architecture Expertise**

* 15+ years of IT experience with at least 6+ years in Enterprise Architecture or equivalent senior architecture leadership roles.
* Proven experience defining enterprise target-state architectures, transformation roadmaps, and architecture governance models.
* Strong experience conducting enterprise assessments and application portfolio rationalization initiatives.
* Solid understanding of enterprise architecture frameworks and modelling approaches such as TOGAF, ArchiMate, Zachman, or equivalent.

* Strong technical foundation with demonstrated ability to architect and guide delivery of large-scale, complex enterprise systems.

+ Expertise in cloud-native architectures, microservices, API-led integration, event-driven systems, and distributed architectures.
+ Experience designing systems for scalability, resilience, security, high availability, and performance.

+ Ability to define high-level GenAI solution architectures involving enterprise knowledge bases, document search, summarization, workflow automation, and conversational interfaces.

* Ability to influence senior stakeholders, lead architecture teams, and steer complex transformation programs.
* Strong communication, consulting, and presentation skills, including experience delivering thought leadership.

**Certifications (Preferred)**

* Architecture and cloud certifications such as AWS/Azure/GCP certifications or similar.

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
**About Salesforce**
We’re Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI+ Data +CRM. Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer, too — driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good – you’ve come to the right place.
  
  
Cloud Success is a specialized team within Customer Success, bringing together customer support engineers, proactive monitoring, specialist product advisors and technical architects. This team not only resolves technical issues but also provides expert guidance on optimizing and leveraging Salesforce technology to drive long-term business success.
  
  
Success Architects, as part of Cloud Success, play a pivotal role in supporting Salesforce’s most critical and strategic customers. They provide expert guidance on solution design, ensuring scalability, security, and adherence to best practices. By assessing system performance, they help optimize efficiency and reliability while proactively identifying risks and recommending improvements to maintain technical health. Additionally, they offer strategic insights into application lifecycle management, enabling customers to plan, develop, and evolve their Salesforce implementations effectively. Through deep expertise, Success Architects empower businesses to maximize their Salesforce investment, aligning technology with business goals for long-term success.
  
  
The Success Architect collaborates closely with various teams across Customer Success and the Product organization to drive long-term solutions for customers. They work with support engineers to resolve immediate technical challenges while identifying root causes to prevent future issues. By bridging the gap between customers, support, and product development, Success Architects help create sustainable solutions that enhance the overall Salesforce experience.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities:****

You will help the team stay at the forefront of Service Cloud innovations, ensuring they are equipped with the latest product developments, best practices and emerging trends.

title: Senior Product Security Architect
description:
**Business Unit:**
Cubic Transportation Systems
  
  
**Company Details:**
When you join Cubic, you become part of a company that creates and delivers technology solutions in transportation to make people’s lives easier by simplifying their daily journeys, and defense capabilities to help promote mission success and safety for those who serve their nation. Led by our talented teams around the world, Cubic is committed to solving global issues through innovation and service to our customers and partners.
  
  
We have a top-tier portfolio of businesses, including Cubic Transportation Systems (CTS) and Cubic Defense (CD). Explore more on Cubic.com.
  
  
**Job Details:**
**Summary:**
We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Product Security Architect who will be responsible for embedding security into the entire product lifecycle—from design to deployment—while enabling secure innovation at scale.
  
  
As a senior leader, you will define the product security strategy, influence engineering practices, and ensure security is a core pillar of product development rather than an afterthought. You will partner closely with engineering, DevOps, cloud, and business leaders to mitigate risks while accelerating delivery.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Security Architecture & Strategy
* Define and implement product security architecture frameworks and standards.
* Integrate Security-by-Design and Privacy-by-Design principles into all products.
* Establish a long-term product security roadmap aligned with business strategy.
* Lead threat modeling and risk assessments for critical products and platforms.
* Provide architectural guidance for:

+ Cloud-native applications
+ Microservices and APIs
+ SaaS and enterprise platforms

* Drive adoption of security frameworks including:

+ NIST Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF) – NIST SP 800-218
+ OWASP SAMM (Software Assurance Maturity Model)

* Secure SDLC (Software Development Lifecycle)
* Design and implement a Secure SDLC (SSDLC) framework across teams.
* Embed security controls across:

+ Design
+ Development
+ Testing
+ Deployment

* Define and enforce:

+ Secure coding standards
+ Secure coding practices
+ DevSecOps integration

* Ensure adoption of:

+ SAST (Static Application Security Testing)
+ DAST (Dynamic Application Security Testing)
+ SCA (Software Composition Analysis)
+ Penetration Testing frameworks

* Establish security maturity metrics and SSDLC governance aligned with NIST SSDF and OWASP SAMM.
* Engineering & DevSecOps Enablement
* Partner with engineering teams to shift security left.
* Drive adoption of DevSecOps practices and automation.
* Enable teams through:

+ Security training and awareness
+ Secure coding guidelines
+ Architecture reviews

* Implement and govern CI/CD security controls and secure pipeline configurations.
* Act as a trusted advisor to engineering leadership.
* Vulnerability & Risk Management
* Oversee application and product vulnerability management lifecycle.
* Define prioritization frameworks based on:

+ Risk severity
+ Business impact

* Drive remediation programs and SLAs.
* Conduct:

+ Penetration testing reviews
+ Security assessments

* Interpret and prioritize findings from SAST, DAST, SCA, and penetration testing activities.
* Cloud & Infrastructure Security
* Provide security architecture for:

+ AWS / Azure / GCP environments
+ Container security (Docker, Kubernetes)

* Define controls for:

+ Identity & Access Management (IAM)
+ Data protection (encryption, key management)
+ Network security

* Regulatory Compliance & Governance
* Ensure compliance with industry standards:

+ ISO 27001
+ SOC 2
+ GDPR and Data Privacy regulations

* Implement audit-ready processes and controls.
* Partner with risk teams for:

+ Security audits
+ Compliance assessments

* Leadership & Stakeholder Management
* Lead and mentor a team of Product Security Engineers and Architects.
* Collaborate with:

+ Engineering leadership
+ Product management
+ Cybersecurity teams
+ External vendors and partners

* Influence senior stakeholders on:

+ Security investments
+ Risk posture
+ Strategic priorities

* Incident Readiness & Response
* Support security incident handling related to product vulnerabilities.
* Define incident response playbooks for product security risks.
* Conduct post-incident reviews and improve controls.

**Required Qualifications**
**Education**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in:

+ Computer Science
+ Information Security
+ Engineering
+ Related field

**Experience**

* 12–18+ years of experience in:

+ Application Security
+ Product Security
+ Security Architecture
+ DevSecOps

* Proven experience in a leadership role (Senior Manager / Architect level).
* Hands-on expertise in:

+ Secure application design
+ Threat modeling
+ Security architecture
+ Secure SDLC implementation

**Technical Skills**
**Strong knowledge of:**

* OWASP Top 10
* Secure coding standards
* API security
* NIST Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF) – SP 800-218
* OWASP SAMM (Software Assurance Maturity Model)

**Experience with:**

* Cloud security (AWS / Azure / GCP)
* Container and Kubernetes security
* CI/CD pipelines and DevOps tools
* Implementation of CI/CD security controls and secure pipeline configurations
* DevSecOps frameworks and automation

**Strong understanding of:**

* SAST (Static Application Security Testing)
* DAST (Dynamic Application Security Testing)
* SCA (Software Composition Analysis)
* Penetration Testing methodologies and frameworks
* Security testing and vulnerability remediation workflows

**Familiarity with:**

* SIEM and monitoring tools
* Security orchestration and automation tools

**Certifications (Preferred)**

* CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional)
* CSSLP (Certified Secure Software Lifecycle Professional)
* CISM / CISA
* AWS Security Specialty
* Microsoft Azure Security Engineer
* Relevant DevSecOps or Cloud Security certifications

**Leadership Competencies**

* Strategic thinking with strong execution focus.
* Ability to influence without authority.
* Strong stakeholder management at the leadership level.
* Problem-solving and risk-based decision making.
* Ability to translate technical risks into business impact.
* Strong communication and executive presentation skills.

**Success Metrics (KPIs)**

* Reduction in critical vulnerabilities across products.
* Adoption rate of Secure SDLC practices.
* Improvement in security posture and audit outcomes.
* Reduction in time-to-remediation.
* Increased awareness and secure coding adoption across teams.
* Improvement in SSDLC maturity and DevSecOps adoption.

**Why This Role Is Critical**
This role is central to ensuring that security scales with innovation. As organizations move toward cloud-native, API-driven, and digital-first ecosystems, the Product Security Architect ensures:
  
  

* Security is embedded, not bolted on.
* Risks are proactively managed rather than reactively addressed.
* Engineering teams are enabled, not slowed down by security.
* Secure development practices become part of the organizational culture.

‎
  
  
**Worker Type:**
Employee
  
  
‎
  
  
*We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. We do not discriminate based on any protected characteristic under applicable law.*

title: AI Solution Architect
description:
**ROLE SUMMARY:**
We are looking for an AI Solution Architect who can take an enterprise AI initiative from vision to execution. You will shape AI strategy with C-level stakeholders, architect cloud-native GenAI and ML platforms on Azure and Databricks, and lead cross-functional teams across data science, MLOps and product engineering to deliver them. You are equally comfortable presenting a roadmap to a board, reviewing a RAG pipeline design and coaching an engineer through a production incident.
  
  
**Experience**

* 12+ years in data, analytics or software engineering, including 5+ years leading AI/ML platforms or products in an enterprise setting
* Proven record of taking ML and GenAI solutions into production at scale, with measurable business impact
* Hands-on delivery of at least one production LLM/RAG solution, plus hands-on experience with agentic AI patterns
* Experience leading multidisciplinary teams and presenting to C-level executives
* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Data Science, Engineering, Statistics or a related field

**Cloud & MLOps:**
Azure (ADF, Azure ML, Synapse, Event Hubs, Key Vault), Databricks, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, CI/CD
  
  
**Data & ML:**
Python, SQL, PySpark, MLflow, TensorFlow, Gurobi, Dataiku, SAS, Alteryx
  
  
**GenAI & Agentic AI:**
OpenAI and other LLMs, LangChain, Milvus / vector databases, RAG, prompt engineering, memory agents, NLP, LLM evaluation
  
  
**BI & Visualisation:**
Power BI, Tableau, Spotfire, Qlik
  
  
**Leadership Competencies:**

* AI strategy and roadmap execution
* AI/ML product lifecycle management
* Responsible AI and governance
* Stakeholder engagement and executive communication
* Training, change management and AI adoption
* Cross-functional team leadership
* Vendor and partner collaboration

**Nice to Have**

* Certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure AI Engineer, Databricks ML Professional or TOGAF
* Experience with AWS or GCP AI services, or multi-cloud architectures
* Industry exposure in financial services, energy, healthcare, manufacturing or the public sector
* Experience designing or delivering AI training and enablement content

**SUCCESS IN THE FIRST 12 MONTHS**

* An agreed AI roadmap and reference architecture adopted across key client engagements
* At least two GenAI or ML solutions in production with tracked business value
* A working Responsible AI and MLOps framework reused by delivery teams
* A high-performing, cross-functional team and a strong bench of client executive relationships

**Reports to: Chief Executive Officer / Head of AI**
**Requirements**
**AI Strategy & Leadership**

* Define and own AI strategy and multi-year roadmaps aligned to client and C-level business priorities, with clear value metrics (revenue, cost, risk, productivity)
* Lead the full AI/ML product lifecycle: opportunity discovery, business case, architecture, build, deployment, adoption and value tracking
* Build, mentor and lead agile delivery teams spanning data scientists, ML/MLOps engineers, data engineers and product managers
* Act as a trusted advisor to executives, translating complex technical options into clear decisions on investment, risk and trade-offs

**Solution Architecture & Delivery**

* Architect enterprise-grade, cloud-native AI/ML and analytics platforms on Azure (ADF, Azure ML, Synapse, Event Hubs, Key Vault) and Databricks
* Design and deliver GenAI and agentic AI solutions: LLM integrations (OpenAI and others), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases (e.g. Milvus), prompt engineering, memory-enabled agents and NLP pipelines
* Establish MLOps foundations using MLflow, Docker, Kubernetes and Terraform for reproducible training, CI/CD, monitoring and scalable model serving
* Set architecture standards, reference designs and reusable components that reduce time-to-production across engagements
* Guide data and analytics solutions end to end, from pipelines (Python, SQL, PySpark) to optimisation (Gurobi) and BI dashboards (Power BI, Tableau, Spotfire, Qlik)

**Responsible AI & Governance**

* Define and embed Responsible AI practices: fairness, explainability, privacy, security, model risk management and human oversight
* Design governance for GenAI, including evaluation frameworks, guardrails, hallucination and prompt-injection controls, cost monitoring and audit trails
* Ensure solutions comply with relevant regulations and client policies (e.g. PDPA, GDPR, MAS FEAT principles where applicable)

**Stakeholder, Change & Adoption**

* Engage business, IT, security and risk stakeholders to align scope, secure buy-in and manage expectations
* Lead training, change management and AI adoption programmes so solutions are used, trusted and sustained
* Manage vendor and partner relationships (cloud providers, LLM providers, platform and SI partners), including evaluation, selection and commercial input
* Produce clear executive communication: roadmaps, status reports, value realisation reviews and steering committee materials

title: Solution Architect - BY
description:
**CREATIVITY IS OUR SUPERPOWER.** 
 It’s our heritage and it’s also our future. Because we don’t just make toys. We create innovative products and experiences that inspire fans, entertain audiences and develop children through play. Mattel is at its best when every member of our team feels respected, included, and heard—when everyone can show up as themselves and do their best work every day. We value and share an infinite range of ideas and voices that evolve and broaden our perspectives with a reach that extends into all our brands, partners, and suppliers.
   

  

**The Team:**
**The Opportunity:**
**What Your Impact Will Be**
 We are seeking an experienced Blue Yonder (formerly JDA) ESP Solution Architect/Developer to lead the design, configuration, development and deployment of Enterprise Supply Planning solutions. This role will play a pivotal part in enabling global supply chain transformation by leveraging Blue Yonder’s advanced planning capabilities to optimize supply planning, inventory positioning, and production strategies. The candidate must be willing to work on site 4 days a week in Hyderabad, during US EST time zone.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Architecture \& Design**
* Lead and own the end\-to\-end architecture and design of Blue Yonder ESP (Enterprise Supply Planning) solutions.
* Translate business requirements into scalable solution designs that align with industry best practices and Blue Yonder's functional framework.
* Define planning models, network design, constraints, and heuristics aligned to business supply strategies.
* Expertise in interpreting solver results ensuring optimized planning quality based on constraints.


**Configuration \& Development**
* Configure and develop components within Blue Yonder ESP, including supply planning, inventory balancing, pegging, and constraint\-based planning logic.
* Customize ESP engines to align with business supply network models, demand signals, and production capacities.
* Create and manage planning parameters, supply chain hierarchies, and master data elements.


**Implementation \& Configuration**
* Configure ESP modules including supply planning, constrained planning, and inventory optimization.
* Guide integration of ESP with up/downstream systems (Demand Planning, ERP, MRP, MES, Google Datalake).
* Oversee data modeling, master data configuration, and rule\-based planning logic.


**Technical Leadership \& Governance**
* Provide leadership and guidance to implementation teams and technical consultants.
* Review and approve functional and technical design documents.
* Ensure adherence to Blue Yonder standards and change management protocols.


**Business Collaboration \& Change Enablement**
* Collaborate with business stakeholders across supply chain, manufacturing, and IT to gather requirements and align solution outcomes.
* Conduct design workshops, walkthroughs, and training sessions to ensure knowledge transfer and user adoption.
* Act as the primary point of contact for solution design decisions and issue resolution.


**Continuous Improvement \& Support**
* Identify and propose enhancements for planning performance, configuration, or data integration.
* Support hypercare and transition to steady\-state planning operations.
* Evaluate emerging Blue Yonder capabilities and industry trends to evolve the planning landscape.
* Contribute to production support and documenting processes and facilitating enablement sessions to empower stakeholders with the necessary skills and knowledge to utilize BY ESP solutions effectively.
* Education Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field.
* Experience 10\+ years of experience in supply chain planning, with at least 5\+ years in Blue Yonder ESP architecture or implementation.
* Technical Skills Hands\-on expertise in configuring, designing and deploying Blue Yonder ESP modules (Supply Planning, Inventory Optimization, S\&OP, Manufacturing Planning) solutions and managing Control\-M with extensive experience of MAP solver and ability to understand and interpret solver output ensuring optimal planning results. Strong understanding of planning algorithms (constrained/unconstrained), pegging, and network optimization. Scripting (e.g., PL/SQL, Python, or batch scripting) skill is a must. Experience with integration to ERP systems like SAP, Oracle, or Infor. Familiarity with data integration tools (e.g., SAP PI, MuleSoft, Informatica) and batch/scheduled data feeds.
* Leadership Skills Excellent communication, leadership, and client\-facing skills.
* Problem\-Solving Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities, with a proactive approach to addressing challenges.
* Cultural Awareness Ability to work effectively in a multicultural and highly dynamic environment and manage teams across different time zones. Must be multi\-tasker and able to prioritize and deliver assignments with the highest quality under pressure with short deadlines.
* Preferred Qualifications
* Blue Yonder certification in ESP or SCPO suite is highly desirable.
* Experience in scripting (e.g., PL/SQL, Python, or batch scripting) is a significant advantage especially OIL scripts.
* Experience in deploying complex BOM, Load building planning, dynamic deployment functionality is highly preferred.
* Experience in SPARQ solver is a plus.
* Experience in large\-scale global supply chain transformation programs.
* Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience working in Agile or hybrid implementation methodologies.
* Knowledge of other Blue Yonder modules (Demand Planning, Sequencing, Control Tower) is a plus.
* Knowledge of Anaplan (planning) models is a plus.


 Don’t meet every single requirement? At Mattel, we are dedicated to an inclusive workplace and a culture of belonging. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
   

  

**How We Work**
 We are a purpose driven company aiming to empower generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. We live up to our purpose employing the following behaviors
   

  

* We collaborate Being a part of Mattel means being part of one team with shared values and common goals. Every person counts and working closely together always brings better results. Partnership is our process and our collective capabilities is our superpower.
* We innovate At Mattel we always aim to find new and better ways to create innovative products and experiences. No matter where you work in the organization, you can always make a difference and have real impact. We welcome new ideas and value new initiatives that challenge conventional thinking.
* We execute We are a performance\-driven company. We strive for excellence and are focused on pursuing best\-in\-class outcomes. We believe in accountability and ownership and know that our people are at their best when they are empowered to create and deliver results.


**Our Approach to Flexible Work:**
 We embrace a flexible work model designed to empower a culture of growth, optimism, and wellbeing, where every employee can reach their full potential. Combining purposeful in\-person collaboration with flexibility, our focus is to optimize performance and drive connection for moments that matter.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 Mattel is a leading global toy and family entertainment company and owner of one of the most iconic brand portfolios in the world. We engage consumers and fans through our franchise brands, including Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher\-Price, American Girl, Thomas \& Friends, UNO, Masters of the Universe, Matchbox, Monster High, MEGA and Polly Pocket, as well as other popular properties that we own or license in partnership with global entertainment companies. Our offerings include toys, content, consumer products, digital and live experiences. Our products are sold in collaboration with the world’s leading retail and ecommerce companies. Since its founding in 1945, Mattel is proud to be a trusted partner in empowering generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential.
   

  

 Mattel’s award\-winning workplace culture has been recognized by Forbes, Fast Company, Newsweek, Great Place to Work, TIME, and more.
   

  

 Visit us at https //jobs.mattel.com/ and www.instagram.com/MattelCareers .
   

  

 Mattel is an Equal Opportunity Employer where we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day. We welcome all job seekers, and all applicants will receive consideration for employment.

 Tidyhire

**Job Description**
**Embedded Architect**
**13 – 20 Years Experience.**
 We are looking for an experienced
 **Embedded Architect** 
 with strong expertise in
 **C\+\+, Embedded Systems, and RTOS** 
 to define and drive the architecture of complex embedded products. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience designing real\-time embedded software, developing scalable architectures, and leading technical decisions across firmware and embedded software teams.
   

  

 You will work closely with engineering, product, hardware, and systems teams to translate product requirements into robust, reliable, and high\-performance embedded solutions.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Define the software architecture and technical roadmap for complex embedded systems.
* Design scalable, modular, and reusable embedded software architectures.
* Develop and review embedded software using modern C\+\+.
* Design and implement real\-time systems using RTOS such as FreeRTOS, Zephyr, QNX, VxWorks, or similar.
* Define task/thread architecture, scheduling, inter\-task communication, synchronization, memory management, and interrupt handling.
* Drive architectural decisions related to performance, latency, reliability, scalability, and resource utilization.
* Collaborate with hardware, firmware, systems, and product engineering teams on end\-to\-end product architecture.
* Establish coding standards, design patterns, development methodologies, and best practices.
* Review architecture, design documents, source code, and technical implementations.
* Mentor senior engineers and technical leads and provide technical direction to embedded development teams.
* Troubleshoot complex system\-level issues involving concurrency, timing, memory, hardware/software interfaces, and real\-time performance.
* Drive technical investigations, proof\-of\-concepts, and evaluation of new embedded technologies.
* Support product development through design, development, integration, testing, and production.
* Ensure compliance with relevant embedded software quality, safety, and security standards where applicable.


**Programming**
* Strong proficiency in C and C\+\+.
* Excellent understanding of modern C\+\+ concepts, preferably C\+\+11/14/17 or later.
* Object\-oriented programming, templates, STL, design patterns, memory management, and multithreading.
* Strong understanding of low\-level programming and resource\-constrained environments.


**RTOS**
* Strong hands\-on experience with at least one RTOS, such as:
+ FreeRTOS
+ Zephyr
+ QNX
+ VxWorks
+ ThreadX
+ Embedded Linux real\-time environments


**Embedded Systems**
* Strong understanding of microcontrollers/microprocessors and embedded architectures.
* Experience with hardware/software interfaces and peripheral drivers.
* Knowledge of communication protocols such as SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, Ethernet, USB, or similar.
* Experience with bootloaders, device drivers, BSPs, firmware architecture, and hardware abstraction layers.
* Understanding of memory architecture, DMA, interrupts, caches, and low\-level debugging.


**Embedded Linux**
* Strong understanding of Embedded Linux is preferred.
* Experience with Linux kernel, device drivers, BSP, boot process, cross\-compilation, and build systems is an advantage.
* Experience with Yocto/Buildroot is desirable.


**Architecture \& Design**
* Strong understanding of embedded software architecture and system design.
* Experience with modular, layered, component\-based, and event\-driven architectures.
* Knowledge of UML, architecture/design documentation, and design patterns.
* Ability to evaluate architectural trade\-offs involving performance, memory, reliability, maintainability, and scalability.
* Experience designing systems involving multiple processors, communication interfaces, or distributed embedded components is preferred.

title: Sr. Application Architect
description:
**Description**
 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and
   

  

 fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.
   

  

 Are you an experienced cloud architect/developer who can assist customers in designing and developing cloud\-native, AI\-integrated applications and/or re\-engineering applications to fully leverage the AWS Cloud? Do you like working on game\-changing projects at the forefront of application development, AI Agents, and cloud technology adoption?
   

  

 AWS ProServe India LLP is looking for highly talented hands\-on technical architects to accelerate our growing Professional Services business in India. You'll join Amazon's world\-class technical teams, working on diverse projects including reimagining customer agent\-enabled applications, modernization, Generative AI adoption, and AI\-DLC application development.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 Design and build well\-architected, cloud\-native applications leveraging AWS services (EC2, ECS, Elastic Beanstalk, Auto Scaling, etc.)
   

  

 Architect AI/ML solutions using AWS AI services (Bedrock, SageMaker, Amazon Q, Rekognition, Comprehend)
   

  

 Guide customers through the AI Development Life Cycle (AI\-DLC) — from data readiness and model development to deployment and continuous improvement
   

  

 Design Generative AI and Agentic AI architectures that are secure, scalable, and cost\-optimized
   

  

 Advise on responsible AI practices including governance, explainability, and bias detection
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 We are looking for hands\-on architects/developers who are passionate about:
   

  

* Help internal customers make decisions on their cloud and AI journey, define scalable architecture, highly available solutions that leverage AWS services and AI capabilities
* Assisting internal customers to architect and develop applications that are cloud\-optimized and AI\-integrated, including Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions
* Working as a technical leader alongside customer business, development, and infrastructure teams
* Guiding customers through the AI Development Life Cycle (AI\-DLC), from problem framing, data readiness, and model selection to deployment, evaluation, and continuous improvement
* Sharing deep software development knowledge with respect to cloud architecture, AI design patterns, and programming
* Advising and implementing AWS best practices for both cloud\-native and AI\-powered workloads
* Assisting internal customers in infrastructure, application development, and AI solution integration
* Assisting internal customers in agile software development and Implementation of DevOps practices
* Independently leading a team that delivers applications including AI\-enabled features spanning the full software lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance strategy
* Scoping development efforts, identifying risks, and prioritizing deliverables to meet organizational goals; providing guidance so your team designs solutions making the right trade\-offs between innovation, speed, and operational excellence


**About The Team**
